I borrowed a multimeter from my brother, how exactly do I go about testing it and what am I looking for to diagnose it?

The wire that runs from the ignition to the starter(usually red or yellow and larger than the others) is going to have the security system box in between.

You want to turn the key to the ON position with the mutimeter hooked to this wire on the ignition side of the box and to ground.(it may help to hold the probes in place, while a friend turns the ignition to the START position.) When the switch is turned to the Start position you should see 12v(set your meter to 20v DC) on the wire(this would mean the ignition itself is good.)

If the ignition is good and sending voltage, you need to find the same wire where it leaves the box and goes to the starter. Test for voltage here, while a friend turn the ignition to the Start position. If you get no voltage leaving the security box, the security system is junk and needs to be removed.
